name: Primus Digital Concierge
description: Information agent for Primus Digital, a digital studio in Zagazig, Sharqia, Egypt. Answers questions about the four disciplines (BUILD, AUTOMATE, FILM, GROW), published work, how engagements are scoped and quoted, areas served, and how to start. The studio publishes no price list. Responds synchronously in plain text; understands English and Arabic keywords.

skills.name: Agency information
skills.description: Answers questions about Primus Digital's disciplines, published work, how engagements are scoped and quoted, and areas served in Egypt.
examples: How do you price a SaaS build?

skills.name: Start an engagement
skills.description: Provides the WhatsApp free-audit flow and contact channels to begin working with the agency.
examples: How do I contact Primus Digital?
I want a free audit of my page
